title: Business Idioms 1
completion_message: ¡Fabuloso! Con estos modismos (idioms), tu nivel de inglés en reuniones de negocios será indistinguible de un hablante nativo muy articulado.

parts.visual:
Empezar y Agilizar: 
- Get the ball rolling (Poner las cosas en marcha / Empezar). 
Ej: Let's get the ball rolling on this project. 
- Up to speed (Al día / Informado). 
Ej: I need to get up to speed on the new regulations.
parts.audio: Starting and Speeding up. 'Get the ball rolling' means to start a process or project. For example: Let's get the ball rolling on this project. 'Up to speed' means fully informed or updated. For example: I need to get up to speed on the new regulations.

parts.visual:
Creatividad y Calidad: 
- Think outside the box (Pensar de forma creativa / Fuera de lo común). 
Ej: To solve this, we need to think outside the box. 
- Cut corners (Tomar atajos / Hacer algo mal para ahorrar dinero o tiempo). 
Ej: We cannot cut corners on safety.
parts.audio: Creativity and Quality. 'Think outside the box' means to think creatively or unconventionally. For example: To solve this, we need to think outside the box. 'Cut corners' means to do something poorly or incompletely to save time or money. For example: We cannot cut corners on safety.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el modismo (idiom) correcto para completar la oración.

questions.question: Let's get the ball ____ on the new marketing campaign. (Poner las cosas en marcha).
questions.explanation: Get the ball rolling = empezar, poner en marcha.

questions.question: I've been on vacation for two weeks. I need to get up to ____. (Ponerme al día / Informarme).
questions.explanation: Get up to speed = ponerse al día, actualizarse con la información.

questions.question: We need to find a unique solution. Let's think outside the ____. (Pensar de forma creativa).
questions.explanation: Think outside the box = pensar fuera de lo convencional.

questions.question: If we ____ corners on materials, the final product will be terrible. (Tomar atajos para ahorrar dinero).
questions.explanation: Cut corners = tomar atajos, sacrificar calidad para ahorrar dinero/tiempo.

questions.question: We are not making progress. We are just going around in ____. (Dando vueltas en círculo).
questions.explanation: Go around in circles = dar vueltas sobre lo mismo sin avanzar.

questions.question: I have too many projects right now. I have a lot on my ____. (Tener mucho plato / Estar muy ocupado).
questions.explanation: Have a lot on my plate = estar muy ocupado, tener muchas responsabilidades.

questions.question: We are on the same ____ regarding the budget. (Estamos de acuerdo / En sintonía).
questions.explanation: Be on the same page = estar de acuerdo, tener el mismo entendimiento.

questions.question: That project is on the back ____ for now. We have other priorities. (En segundo plano / Pospuesto).
questions.explanation: On the back burner = en segundo plano, pospuesto temporalmente.

questions.question: Let's call it a ____. We've been working for 12 hours. (Dar por terminado el día).
questions.explanation: Call it a day = terminar de trabajar por el día.

questions.question: I don't know the exact number, but as a ____ park figure, I'd say $50,000. (Una cifra aproximada).
questions.explanation: A ballpark figure = una cifra aproximada, un estimado.

questions.question: I need to touch ____ with you about the presentation tomorrow. (Contactar brevemente).
questions.explanation: Touch base = contactar o comunicarse brevemente con alguien.

questions.question: He didn't explain the details. He just gave us the big ____. (El panorama general).
questions.explanation: The big picture = el panorama general, la situación completa.

questions.question: It's a long shot, but we might win the contract. ('Long shot' = ?)
questions.explanation: A long shot = algo poco probable que tenga éxito, pero vale la pena intentar.

questions.question: We had to go back to square ____ after the client rejected the idea. (Volver al principio).
questions.explanation: Back to square one = volver al punto de partida.

questions.question: She is a very proactive manager. She is always on the ____. (Atenta / Alerta / Eficiente).
questions.explanation: On the ball = estar muy atento, ser rápido y eficiente.

questions.question: Don't beat around the ____. Tell me exactly what the problem is! (Irse por las ramas).
questions.explanation: Beat around the bush = irse por las ramas, no ir al grano.

questions.question: We need to learn the ____ before we can manage the whole project. (Aprender cómo funcionan las cosas básicas).
questions.explanation: Learn the ropes = aprender las cuerdas, aprender cómo se hace un trabajo.

questions.question: The new rules are very strict, we must do everything by the ____. (Siguiendo las reglas al pie de la letra).
questions.explanation: By the book = estrictamente según las reglas.

questions.question: I heard through the ____ that the CEO is resigning. (Por los rumores / Me enteré por ahí).
questions.explanation: Through the grapevine = por los rumores, me enteré extraoficialmente.

questions.question: This company is in the ____. We are losing money every month. (En números rojos).
questions.explanation: In the red = en números rojos (perdiendo dinero). In the black = dando ganancias.
